external_primary_sources.title: Quantifier elimination for the reals with a predicate for the powers of two
external_primary_sources.version: arXiv:cs/0610117v1; title page 19 October 2006, manuscript date 9 May 2006
external_primary_sources.read_scope: Sections 1-2, axioms for the fixed 2^Z predicate, the definitional lambda and D_k expansion, Theorem 2.1 and the constructive two-step elimination description.
external_primary_sources.applicability: Unconditional decidability of one fixed discrete-power expansion of the real field. D_k has a fixed integer index in each predicate symbol; no variable-base power relation is included.

external_primary_sources.authors: Lou van den Dries and Ayhan Gunaydin
external_primary_sources.title: The fields of real and complex numbers with a small multiplicative group
external_primary_sources.read_scope: Introduction and Section 8, especially the full argument of Proposition 8.7 and Corollary 8.8.
external_primary_sources.applicability: Effective cyclic Mann property and decidability for a supplied positive algebraic generator. This does not supply elimination over an existentially varying predicate/base or an effective arbitrary-group source classifier.

external_primary_sources.author: Yu. V. Matiyasevich
external_primary_sources.title: Diophantine representation of enumerable predicates
external_primary_sources.read_scope: Primary publication record and abstract explicitly stating the enumerable-predicate theorem and the algorithmic unsolvability consequence for Hilbert's tenth problem; standard theorem used, not reproved.
external_primary_sources.applicability: Used only to exclude a definable copy of the natural numbers in an effectively decidable real-field expansion. It is not a reduction of Diophantine solvability to original source recognition.

authentication: Five prior arithmetic/lattice bodies were freshly fetched at a3f203a7 and seven source/carrier bodies were recovered from exact prior captures; all twelve copies were authenticated by SHA-256 and Git blob. Two governing master/scope identities retain prior exact readbacks.
source_convention: The repeated family assigns equal numerical tuples to selected fresh positions as a witness family. It does not introduce an original input instruction tying arbitrarily many fresh sites, nor prove that every rival has that presentation.
logical_scope: The derivative is an alternating-quantifier first-order construction at an interior parameter value. It is not a legal original observation. Supplied algebraic (b,t,y) membership is decidable as recorded in the binding companion.
attribution: Exact paired source laws, append grammar, finite core reduction, carrier and arithmetic/lattice gates are inherited. Fixed-cyclic elimination is prior model theory. The explicit paired run and elementary definability argument are the submitted application; novelty is unassessed.
verification: Hand mathematics and primary theorem reading only. No mathematical execution, source scan, compiler, simulation or proof assistant.
